name: اذکار
tagline: Daily prayers and dhikr in Persian, Arabic and Kurdish
fa_text: اذکار و دعاهای روزانه به سه زبان فارسی، عربی و کردی سورانی، گردآوری‌شده از منابع معتبر حدیثی.

name: کتابخانه مسلم
tagline: Free Islamic books to read in Persian
fa_text: مطالعه‌ی رایگان کتاب‌های عقیده، حدیث و فقه با ترجمه‌ی فارسی، همراه با ابزارهایی برای مطالعه‌ی عمیق‌تر.

name: خودرو یار
fa_text: دستیار شخصی نگهداری خودرو؛ هر سرویس را دقیقاً وقتی بر اساس کیلومتر یا زمان لازم است یادآوری می‌کند.

name: نماز یار
fa_text: همراه دقیق، آرام و کاملاً آفلاین اوقات نماز، برای فارسی‌زبانان، دری، کردی سورانی، بلوچی و پشتو.

name: Number Forge: Daily Math
tagline: Six numbers. One target. Forge it.

name: Gridlock: Daily Car Puzzle
tagline: Slide the cars. Free the red one. Every par is proven, not estimated.

name: Shikaku: Paper & Ink Logic
tagline: Draw a rectangle around each number so its area matches. There is exactly one way.

name: Zebra: Logic Grid Puzzles
tagline: Read a clue. Cross off what it rules out. Watch the consequences ripple until one arrangement survives.

name: MindForge: Brain Training
tagline: MindForge is a small collection of brain-training games that runs entirely on your phone. Two of the four are the app's own — built on thing

name: Nodelock: Logic Pipes
tagline: One solution. Always. Never a guess.

name: Takuzu: Binary Logic Puzzle
tagline: Binary logic, graded by the technique each board actually needs.

name: Nonogram Darkroom
tagline: Read the numbers. Fill the grid. A picture comes out of it.

name: Pullback
tagline: Push every crate home. Par is the fewest pushes possible — and we can prove it.
